time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; time t -> frame round(t*fps)
units: pixels (x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: static (frames 37-47 are pixel-identical outside compression noise; no background shift at any frame)
camera.view: orthographic-looking top-down view of a coffee table on a shaggy rug; motion plane = table/board top, facing the camera
camera.perspective: negligible: board squares have equal pitch (33.6 px) across the whole board in x and y

moving_objects.name: dark_piece
moving_objects.description: the only moving object: a dark smoky-glass chess piece seen from directly above (round, ~34.3 px diameter), in the 9th of 10 board columns (x ~533.7) starting in the board's top row; it slides straight down the board (image +y) by ~50.3 px (1.5 squares) and stops
moving_objects.distinguish: other dark glass pieces on the board are static (e.g. at (295,690), (499,690), (533,760)); the piece at (533,760) is in the same column but further down and never moves
moving_objects.reference_point: circ_cx, circ_cy = centre of fixed-radius circle fitted to the piece outline (top-down => projection of the piece's vertical axis; best proxy for the origin)

events.event: piece already moving at first frame (moves between frame 0 and 1)
last displacement (frame 35 -> 36); piece at rest from frame 36 on (abrupt stop, no visible slow-down in the steps)
